analyticsNoData: No analytics data is available for this period.

consultSaveError: The case sheet edit could not be saved.
consultActionError: The consultation status could not be changed.
aiAssistedNote: Some history fields were organized with AI assistance and need staff review.
patientConfirmationPending: Not yet confirmed by the patient
patientNeedsAssistance: Patient requested help from a nurse.
pdfExportError: The case sheet PDF could not be prepared.
shortcuts: Shortcuts: N queue · E edit · P print
editConflictMessage: Another staff member saved a newer version. Reload before continuing or apply your edit to the latest version.
nurseOnly: This assisted registration flow is available to nurses.
patientRegisterDescription: Every visit for your department, with filters for date, status and urgency.
recentVisitsDescription: Showing the latest {{count}} visits available to your role.
patientsLoadError: Recent visits could not be loaded. Check the API connection and try again.
noPatientVisits: No patient visits are available yet.
seedDemoHint: For the sample walkthrough, run the seed-demo-data command from the project instructions.
nurseConsoleDescription: Register a patient with their consent and review urgent alerts from the queue.
consentBeforeRegistration: Read the consent notice with the patient. Continue only after they agree; collect their identity details on the next screen.
assistedStartError: Could not start assisted registration. Please try again.
nurseQueueTools: The queue includes alert acknowledgement, department and urgency overrides with a reason, call-next, and no-show actions.
secureSession: Your session is protected and will expire automatically.
loginPrivacy: Your password is sent securely and is never saved in this browser.
invalidCredentials: The hospital ID, email, or password could not be verified.
accountLocked: Sign-in is paused after repeated attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
rateLimited: Too many sign-in requests. Wait a moment and try again.
serviceUnavailable: Sign-in protection is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
lockoutNotice: After five failed attempts, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
adminDescription: Manage staff accounts, registration kiosks, and departments for this hospital.
adminRequestError: The administration request could not be completed.
adminOnly: Administration is available to hospital administrators only.
activationCodeOnce: Copy this code for {{kiosk}} now. For security it is shown only once; if it is lost, choose “New activation code” for this kiosk. Its records are kept.
howItWorksCollection: Approved interview questions collect a patient history. Safety rules flag warning signs for staff review.
howItWorksReview: Patient confirmation, staff review, and the original transcript keep the clinician in control. OPD Saathi does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
aiBriefNote: Written by AI from the patient's own answers. History only, not a diagnosis. Verify with the patient.
consultHintSheet: See the patient's history in English, with their own words alongside.
consultHintEdit: Correct any field — every edit is versioned and audited.
consultHintPdf: Call, start and finish the consultation, then download or print the PDF.
railError: Could not load the patient list. Try refresh.
noPatientsText: Nobody is waiting for a consultation right now. New check-ins appear in the list automatically.
redFlagsExplain: Raised by OPD Saathi's safety rules from what the patient reported. Verify with the patient before acting — this is not a diagnosis.
aiNotVerified: Not verified by staff — compare with the patient's own answers.
aiHelpOff: No AI help: the patient chose to answer without online AI services. This sheet comes from the rules alone, and answers stay in the patient's own words.
aiHelpWithdrawn: The patient stopped AI help for this visit. The AI draft is not shown and nothing more is sent to AI services.
aiHelpStop: Patient asks to stop AI help
aiHelpStopConfirm: Stop AI help for this visit, as the patient asked?
aiHelpStopFailed: Could not stop AI help. Please try again.
workflowCallHint: The token is announced in the waiting room.
workflowConsultHint: Go through the history and red flags with the patient.
workflowCompleteHint: Finish, then download or print the case sheet.
workflowUnknown: Open this patient from the list to see where they are in the workflow.
historyLegend: Each answer shows where it came from. Patient answers are marked by how they gave them (voice, touch or typed); corrections by staff are marked Doctor or Nurse and Staff-verified. Every saved edit creates a new, audited version.
transcriptNote: The patient's own words, exactly as recorded. This record cannot be changed; correct the organized history in Patient history.
doctorNotesIntro: Your own examination findings, assessment and plan. Each save is a new version, printed on the case sheet PDF. Never written by AI.
doctorNotesFailed: Notes not saved. Check the connection and try again.
doctorNotesConflict: Someone saved these notes meanwhile. Their version is shown below and your text is kept above. Save again to replace theirs.
doctorNotesClosed: These notes can no longer be changed: the patient is no longer under care today.
doctorNotesReadOnly: Only a doctor of this department can change these notes.
doctorNotesNeedText: Write findings, an assessment or a plan before saving.
staffEditsTitle: Staff edits on this case sheet
staffEditsNone: No staff edits yet. Corrections made in Patient history appear here.
versionAudit: Version {{version}} · every saved edit creates a new version and an audit-log entry.
patientCorrectionsTitle: Corrections the patient made before confirming
leaveMessage: You are editing “{{field}}”. Leaving now will lose the change.
analyticsExportError: The CSV could not be prepared. Please try again.
analyticsPatientsHelp: Every visit registered in this period, including patients not yet seen. A patient who comes twice counts twice.
analyticsWaitDetail: From joining the queue to the consultation starting
analyticsWaitEmpty: No consultation started in this period.
analyticsConsultDetail: From start to finish of a consultation
analyticsConsultEmpty: No consultation was finished in this period.
analyticsUrgentDetail: Visits marked as needing early attention
analyticsConfirmedDetail: Patient-confirmed case sheets no doctor had to edit
analyticsConfirmedEmpty: No patient confirmed a case sheet in this period.
analyticsDoctorEditDetail: Share of case sheets a doctor corrected
analyticsInterviewDetail: From the first to the last kiosk answer
analyticsInterviewEmpty: No kiosk interview in this period.
analyticsTimeSavedHelp: An estimate, not a measurement: the number of visits multiplied by the minutes of history-taking you assume each kiosk interview saves.
baselineHint: Between 0 and {{max}} minutes; the default is {{fallback}}. Only this estimate changes.
baselineStorage: Applies to the whole hospital: every administrator sees the same estimate.
analyticsTrendCaption: Each bar is one day. Days without visits show as zero. Hover, tap or use the arrow keys for exact numbers.
analyticsAboutText: Figures come from daily totals refreshed every 5 minutes and follow the date range and department chosen above. “No data” means there was nothing to measure; 0 is a real zero.
cannotDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.
staffAccountsHint: Doctors, nurses and administrators who can sign in.
departmentListHint: Departments patients can be sent to.
createUserHint: Add a doctor, nurse or administrator.
createKioskHint: Each kiosk feeds this hospital's single patient queue. A one-time activation code appears after you register it.
createDepartmentHint: Codes and prefixes use capital letters and numbers.
passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Share it with the staff member privately.
kioskLabelHint: Use a name staff will recognise, such as its location.
adminSearchKiosks: Search by kiosk name or ID
confirmDeactivateUser: They will be signed out within a few minutes and can't sign in again until an administrator activates the account.
confirmDeactivateOther: You can activate it again at any time.
analyticsNoSheetsEmpty: No case sheets were created in this period.
analyticsDoctorEditHelp: Edited case sheets divided by visits that produced a case sheet. Check-ins abandoned before the history was taken are not counted.
baselineSaveError: The setting could not be saved. Please try again.
analyticsSettingsError: The time-saved setting could not be loaded.
activationCodeHowTo: On the kiosk device, open the setup link once (or type the code). The kiosk then stays signed in by itself.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the code and copy it by hand.
cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account.
confirmDeleteUsers: They are signed out and removed from this list. Visits and notes they recorded stay in patient history. Their email can be used for a new account.
confirmDeleteKiosks: The device at this kiosk stops working at once and the kiosk is removed from this list. Patients it registered stay in their records. To move a kiosk to a new device instead, use “New activation code”.
confirmDeleteDepartments: It is removed from this list and from staff and kiosk choices. Past visits keep its name. Patients still waiting and staff assigned to it must be moved first.
useAnotherAccountHint: Sign in as someone else in this tab. This account stays signed in on its other tabs.
kioskKindHint: A kiosk screen is set up once with a one-time code. A phone check-in QR is printed, and patients scan it to answer on their own phone.
checkinQrFor: Print this for {{label}}. Patients on the hospital Wi-Fi scan it and answer the questions on their own phone.
checkinQrTest: Test it first: scan it with a phone on the hospital Wi-Fi. The check-in page should open.
checkinQrNoAddress: This PC's Wi-Fi address is not known, so phones cannot open the link yet. Connect to the hospital network and run start-demo.ps1 again.
checkinQrReplaced: New QR ready. Posters with the old QR no longer work.
confirmReplaceQr: Printed posters with the current QR stop working at once. Patients already answering are not affected.
channelPhoneHint: Registered on their own phone: greet and check details at the desk.
previousLoadError: Earlier visits could not be loaded. Today's case sheet is not affected.
previousClosed: Earlier visits are shown only while the patient is under your care today.
previousNone: No earlier visits are linked to this patient: a first visit, or the patient did not use their OPD card.
previousLinkedCard: Linked by the patient's OPD card
previousLinkedStaff: Linked by staff after checking identity
previousKnownNote: Patient-reported at earlier visits. Confirm with the patient today.
linkHint: For a patient without their OPD card: search, check age and sex with the patient, then link.
reissueHint: Find the patient, check their age and sex with them, then give them a new PIN. Their OPD number and records stay the same; the old PIN stops working.
reissueConfirm: Age and sex checked with the patient? The old PIN will stop working.
reissueResultHint: Write the number and PIN on a new card for the patient. The PIN is not shown again.
reissueFailed: The card could not be re-issued. Try again.
reissueChanged: This card was re-issued meanwhile. Search again before re-issuing it.
linkDoctorNote: Patient without their OPD card? A nurse can find and link the earlier record after checking who they are.
markAbsentHint: Give the patient time to come. You can mark them absent when the countdown ends.
recallHint: Back in the queue where they were, with the same token
missedLead: Called but not here. Recall them when they come back: they keep their token and place in the queue.
nurseCheck: The patient tapped a danger sign. A nurse should confirm it in person (acknowledge the alert) or change the priority with a reason.
doctorBusy: Finish with {{token}} first: start the consultation, mark them absent or put them back in the queue.
graceNotOver: Too early to mark absent. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
claimedByOther: Another doctor has called this patient.
consultSkippedNote: This patient was called and was not there. Recall them when they come back.
timelineBySystem: automatically at the end of the day
callGraceLabel: Wait before a patient can be marked absent
callGraceHint: After a call, staff can mark the patient absent only once this time has passed (0–15 minutes). Missed patients keep their token and place for a recall.
callGraceSaved: Saved. Applies to the next call.
aiEditLabel: Summary for the case sheet (your words)
aiRejectedNote: This AI draft was rejected and is not printed.
aiNoSources: This draft is not linked to the patient's answers. Compare it with the responses before using it.
aiReviewConflict: The case sheet changed and has been reloaded. Review the summary again.
aiReviewFailed: Could not save your decision. Try again.
openQuestionsNote: The patient did not know or preferred not to say. These are not denials.
ayurvedaDraftNote: Draft for the vaidya to review. The patient answered the first part at the kiosk; examination findings are recorded here by the clinician and are never asked of the patient.
ayurvedaExamNote: Write what you observe. Leave a field empty if it was not examined.
ayurvedaSaveFailed: Could not save the examination. Try again.
ayurvedaConflict: The case sheet changed and has been reloaded. Your entries are kept; save again.
interviewSettingsHint: Optional parts of every kiosk and phone interview. Each is off until you turn it on.
reviewOfSystemsModuleHint: Adds one screen: "In the last month, have you had any of these?" with one choice per body system. Systems the interview already asked about are left out. Ticked systems go to the case sheet; "None of these" is recorded as a denial of each system shown.
ayurvedaModuleHint: Adds six questions to every kiosk and phone interview: appetite, digestion, bowel habit, sleep, capacity for exertion and diet. The doctor's case sheet gets an Ayurveda tab for examination findings.
interviewSettingsSaved: Saved. Applies to interviews that start from now.
featureSettingsHint: These apply to the whole hospital. New features stay off until you turn them on.
smsMessagesHint: When a patient types a mobile number, kiosks and phones offer a box to tick for SMS; only patients who tick it get messages. Keep this off until the hospital has an SMS provider and registered message templates.
smsNoProvider: This server has no SMS provider yet, so messages are only written to its log.
phoneCheckinLabel: Allow check-in on patients' own phones
phoneCheckinHint: Patients scan a printed check-in QR and answer on their own phone. Turning this off stops every check-in QR at once; kiosks keep working.
featureSettingsSaved: Saved. Applies to check-ins that start from now.
aiSettingsHint: AI writes follow-up questions, translates answers, drafts the doctor's brief and reads photos of papers. It works on a visit only when this is on and the patient agreed; everything else runs on this server.
aiSettingsLabel: Allow online AI help in this hospital
aiSettingsConsent: Each patient still chooses for their own visit, and can stop it at any time.
aiSettingsDefault: No choice saved yet: AI is on by default where the server has it. Save to make the choice explicit.
aiSettingsUnavailable: AI is not set up on this server, so this switch has no effect now. The server operator turns it on.
papersLoadError: Papers could not be loaded. Today's case sheet is not affected.
papersNone: No papers were added at this visit.
papersEarlierClosed: Papers from earlier visits are shown only while the patient is under your care today.
readingSkipped: Not read by AI (the patient did not allow AI help, or AI is off). Read the photo.
readingFailed: AI could not read this paper. Read the photo.
readingUnreadable: AI found nothing it could read clearly. Read the photo.
readingWithdrawn: The patient stopped AI help, so what AI read is not shown. Read the photo.
readingDraft: AI reading · compare with the photo
readingRejected: Rejected by {{name}}: does not match the photo
readingReviewFailed: Could not save your decision. Try again.
flagsNote: Each result is compared only with the range printed beside it on this paper.
timelineNote: Only readings a doctor accepted, from this and earlier visits, oldest first. Each result is compared with the range printed on its own paper.
timelineAwaiting_one: {{count}} paper is waiting for a doctor's decision and is not included.
timelineAwaiting_other: {{count}} papers are waiting for a doctor's decision and are not included.
timelineVisitDate: visit date; no date read on the paper
timelineLoadError: Results over time could not be loaded.
paperAddFailed: Could not add the photo. Try again.
paperAddFull: This visit has the most papers allowed.
paperAddClosed: Papers can be added only while the patient is under care.
paperNotPhoto: That file is not a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
mfaPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfaRecoveryPrompt: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works once.
useRecoveryCode: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
mfaCodeRejected: That code was not accepted. Check the code and your phone's clock, then try again.
mfaChallengeExpired: Sign-in timed out. Enter your password again.
newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well. Avoid your name, the hospital's name and common passwords.
passwordsDoNotMatch: The two new passwords do not match.
choosePasswordWhy: This account was given a temporary password. Choose a new one that only you know to continue.
mfaSetupWhy: Your role needs two-step sign-in: a password and a code from your phone. It takes about a minute.
mfaIntro: You will need an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfaScan: Open your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code. Then type the 6-digit code it shows.
mfaQrTitle: QR code for your authenticator app
mfaSecretLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key instead:
recoveryCodesHint: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Print them or write them down and keep them somewhere safe. They will not be shown again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. You were signed out on your other devices.
mfaOffStatus: Off. Turn it on for stronger protection of patient records.
endOtherSessions: Sign out of all other devices
temporaryPasswordHint: Give it to them in person or by phone, never by email or chat. It is shown only now. They must choose their own password when they sign in, and they were signed out everywhere.
staffMfaReset: Two-step sign-in was removed for {{name}}. They set it up again at their next sign-in.
staffSignedOut: {{name}} was signed out on every device.
auditLogHint: Who did what, and when. Use it to answer a patient's question about who saw their record, or to investigate an account. Every search and export is itself recorded.
auditIdInvalid: A record or staff ID is a full ID such as 0190a1b2-c3d4-7e5f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b.
systemHint: The state of this installation. Problems shown here are also sent to hospital IT as alerts.
systemLoadError: The system status could not be loaded. Try again.
systemVoiceModes: Speech to text: {{stt}} · Text to speech: {{tts}}
answeredBy_guardian: Answered by a parent or guardian
answeredBy_representative: Answered by someone helping the patient
